name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: A partner program only produces revenue when partners know the product well enough to sell it, and someone keeps the pipeline honest in the CRM. That is the work I did at Birdeye, and it is what your Strategic Partnership Manager role measures.

At Birdeye I onboarded and managed 15 to 20 reseller partners with deals from roughly $10K to $45K, and retained all but one. I built the onboarding, training, and automated enablement sequences that got them selling, analyzed utilization to catch partners going quiet, and fed their feedback to Product and Engineering. Before that I spent over two years at Accelo selling CRM and integration-heavy software to professional-services firms, ranking top three on the team while quota roughly doubled, so I can talk integrations and APIs with a technology partner's product lead as easily as with their sales team. I run all of it in HubSpot, which I also build and administer for my own clients.
I would welcome a conversation about which partner categories (ATS, HCM, payroll) you want to grow first, and how I would build the plan for the first two quarters.
